initialization: Copy source sports-ball row into dense row 0 of every 91-row classification head; suppress unused row 1. Preserve all other tensors. Record full checkpoint hashes. Dedicated ball model; never interpret outputs as COCO person classes.
training: Same verified 225 training and 150 validation images. Select best of three epochs by validation mAP only. No test during training. No cloud loggers. Full-frame native resolution setting unchanged from Nano default.
evaluation: Freeze original COCO, transferred-untrained, and selected-trained predictions before scoring. Evaluate class 37 for COCO, only class 0 for ball-only models; class 1 never means person or ball. Same GPU, pixels, confidence 0.3, IoU 0.5. Compare all three on validation and fixed recheck.
acceptance: For both validation and fixed recheck, trained model must retain at least all original matched reference boxes and reduce unmatched predictions by at least 20 percent. Positive baseline match and unmatched counts required. Acceptance permits expanded external validation, not final promotion.
limits: Tiny previously exposed ball-present-only dataset; no absent-ball precision, temporal tracking, camera fusion or possession validation. Best epoch on validation is development selection, not independent evidence.
